resources.string: Your laptop, from across the room.

string-array.name: guide_features_keys
string-array.item: REAL-TIME
ROUND TRIP
OFFLINE
BLUETOOTH
AND MORE

string-array.name: guide_features_values
string-array.item: Every move goes out as you make it. A slow link merges waiting moves instead of queueing them.
Measured live from the phone to the laptop and back, and shown beside the laptop on the Devices screen.
No account, no internet, no Wi-Fi. The phone reaches the laptop directly.
Pair once in the laptop Bluetooth settings. After that Edgepad can connect on launch.
Haptic notches, light and dark, your own media and gamepad layouts.

string-array.name: guide_anatomy_keys
string-array.item: TRACKPAD
CORNER DIALS
MEDIA
KEYBOARD
GAMEPAD

string-array.name: guide_anatomy_values
string-array.item: The whole middle of the screen. Every finger gesture starts here.
Rulers folded into the corners: volume, brightness, zoom, media scrub, app switcher or mic.
What is playing, then previous, play and next, while a player is open. Move and resize it in Settings.
A full keyboard whose modifiers work held or tapped, one tap away.
Sticks, a D-pad and buttons in four presets, or your own arrangement.

string-array.name: guide_surface_keys
string-array.item: ONE FINGER
TWO FINGERS
THREE & FOUR
CORNER DIALS
TUNE IT

string-array.name: guide_surface_values
string-array.item: Move the pointer. Tap to click. Tap, then hold and move, to drag.
Tap to right-click. Slide to scroll. Pinch to zoom.
Three sideways for desktops, up for task view, down for the desktop. Four sideways through open apps. Taps search or open notifications.
Slide along a ruler, clockwise raises. Tap it to mute, play, reset zoom or open task view.
Settings › Corners picks each dial. Dial feel sets sensitivity, size and haptics. Gestures reassigns the rest.

string-array.name: guide_keyboard_keys
string-array.item: OPEN
TYPE
MODIFIERS
CLOSE

string-array.name: guide_keyboard_values
string-array.item: The keyboard icon at the top of the surface. It opens sideways.
Every key goes straight to the laptop: function row, arrows, Esc and Tab included.
Hold Ctrl, Alt or Shift while pressing a key, or tap one to apply it to the next key. Tap it again to cancel.
The back arrow at the top, or the system back gesture.

string-array.name: guide_gamepad_keys
string-array.item: OPEN
PRESETS
PLAY
MAKE IT YOURS

string-array.name: guide_gamepad_values
string-array.item: The gamepad icon at the top of the surface. It opens sideways.
Xbox, Platformer, Racing and Shooter, picked from the options button on the gamepad.
Hold and slide a stick, tap the buttons. Several fingers at once work.
Settings › Gamepad layout. Drag controls where your thumbs land; long press one to resize it.
